name: WWC Website Leads P0.3 — country gate

parameters.query:
WITH supplied AS (
  SELECT
    '{{ String($json.first_ref_code).replace(/'/g, '') }}'::text AS first_ref,
    '{{ String($json.active_ref_code).replace(/'/g, '') }}'::text AS active_ref,
    '{{ String($json.country_code).replace(/'/g, '') }}'::text AS requested_country
), routing AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN first_profile.ref_code IS NOT NULL AND NOT (supplied.requested_country <> 'BY' AND first_profile.owner_id = 'harold') THEN supplied.first_ref ELSE NULL END AS first_ref_code,
    CASE WHEN active_profile.ref_code IS NOT NULL AND NOT (supplied.requested_country <> 'BY' AND active_profile.owner_id = 'harold') THEN supplied.active_ref ELSE NULL END AS active_ref_code,
    CASE WHEN supplied.requested_country <> 'BY' AND COALESCE(active_profile.owner_id, first_profile.owner_id) = 'harold' THEN 'viktor' ELSE COALESCE(active_profile.owner_id, first_profile.owner_id, 'viktor') END AS attributed_owner_id,
    CASE WHEN supplied.requested_country <> 'BY' AND COALESCE(active_profile.owner_id, first_profile.owner_id) = 'harold' THEN 'viktor' ELSE COALESCE(active_profile.owner_id, first_profile.owner_id, 'viktor') END AS assigned_owner_id,
    supplied.requested_country,
    first_profile.profile_version AS ref_profile_version
  FROM supplied
  LEFT JOIN referral_profiles first_profile
    ON first_profile.ref_code = supplied.first_ref
   AND first_profile.tenant_id = '{{ String($json.tenant_id).replace(/'/g, '') }}'
   AND first_profile.enabled = true
  LEFT JOIN referral_profiles active_profile
    ON active_profile.ref_code = supplied.active_ref
   AND active_profile.tenant_id = '{{ String($json.tenant_id).replace(/'/g, '') }}'
   AND active_profile.enabled = true
), service_route AS (
  SELECT sl.service_location_id, sl.country_code, sl.city
  FROM routing
  JOIN service_locations sl ON sl.tenant_id = '{{ String($json.tenant_id).replace(/'/g, '') }}' AND sl.operator_actor_id = routing.assigned_owner_id AND sl.enabled = true
  ORDER BY sl.verified_at DESC NULLS LAST, sl.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
), saved AS (
  INSERT INTO website_leads (
    tenant_id, name, contact, comment, product_name, product_sku, product_variant, page_url,
    initial_ref_code, first_ref_code, active_ref_code, attributed_owner_id, assigned_owner_id,
    ref_profile_version, service_location_id, country_code, city, idempotency_key, metadata
  )
  SELECT
    '{{ String($json.tenant_id).replace(/'/g, '') }}',
    '{{ String($json.name).replace(/'/g, '') }}',
    '{{ String($json.contact).replace(/'/g, '') }}',
    '{{ String($json.comment).replace(/'/g, '') }}',
    '{{ String($json.product_name).replace(/'/g, '') }}',
    '{{ String($json.product_sku).replace(/'/g, '') }}',
    '{{ String($json.product_variant).replace(/'/g, '') }}',
    '{{ String($json.page_url).replace(/'/g, '') }}',
    routing.first_ref_code, routing.first_ref_code, routing.active_ref_code,
    routing.attributed_owner_id, routing.assigned_owner_id, routing.ref_profile_version,
    service_route.service_location_id, COALESCE(service_route.country_code, routing.requested_country), service_route.city,
    '{{ String($json.idempotency_key).replace(/'/g, '') }}',
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata).replace(/'/g, '') }}'::jsonb
  FROM routing
  LEFT JOIN service_route ON true
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now()
  RETURNING lead_id, public_id, (xmax = 0) AS created, attributed_owner_id, assigned_owner_id
), ownership AS (
  INSERT INTO website_lead_owner_history (lead_id, tenant_id, owner_id, action, changed_by, reason)
  SELECT lead_id, '{{ String($json.tenant_id).replace(/'/g, '') }}', assigned_owner_id,
         'created', 'website-p0.1', 'Server-side referral routing'
  FROM saved WHERE created
), status_log AS (
  INSERT INTO website_lead_status_history (lead_id, tenant_id, old_status, new_status, changed_by_actor_id, reason)
  SELECT lead_id, '{{ String($json.tenant_id).replace(/'/g, '') }}', NULL, 'new',
         'website-p0.1', 'Created from website form'
  FROM saved WHERE created
)
SELECT public_id, created, attributed_owner_id, assigned_owner_id FROM saved;
